name: Tegar Haris DD

bio: Software & AI Engineer with 1 year of experience building full stack web applications with JavaScript, React, and Node.js, and applying artificial intelligence with Python, pandas, and scikit-learn to solve data-driven problems.
longBio: Software & AI Engineer with 1 year of experience building full stack web applications with JavaScript, React, and Node.js, and applying artificial intelligence (AI) with Python, pandas, and scikit-learn to solve data-driven problems. Comfortable working across the stack, from accessible UI components to REST APIs, with a growing focus on bringing AI into real-world products. A fast learner who thrives on pair programming, code review, and Agile teamwork, aiming to build a career as an AI Engineer that blends strong software engineering with applied AI.

points: Labeled and annotated large-scale datasets in accordance with defined project guidelines.
Consistently validated content accuracy against quality standards and deadlines, ensuring high-integrity training data.
Designed and developed an automated Telegram chatbot prototype using n8n workflow automation.
Integrated the chatbot with an LLM (Large Language Model) API to generate efficient, data-driven, and interactive automated responses.
Configured Webhook and ngrok for real-time data exchange between the chatbot and backend services.
Tools: Excel, Python, n8n, Telegram Bot API, Webhook, ngrok.

Built and managed the backend database using Supabase (PostgreSQL).
Set up a CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions for automated deployment.
